title: Quantum-referenced refractive-index calibration of air at 1762 nm for environmental phase compensation in quantum optical interfaces
description: Data and analysis scripts for the quantum-referenced calibration of the refractive index of air at 1762 nm (the 138Ba+ clock transition wavelength), based on 145,784 synchronized dual-wavelength interferometric and environmental measurements from January to August 2025. Version 2.0 updates the analysis to a same-condition comparison with the Mathar model, an offset-fair compensation assessment, and a rebuilt uncertainty budget, superseding version 1.0.
references: Mathar, R. J. (2007). Refractive index of humid air in the infrared: model fits. Journal of Optics A, 9(5), 470.
Ciddor, P. E. (1996). Refractive index of air: new equations for the visible and near infrared. Applied Optics, 35(9), 1566-1573.
Arnold, K. J. et al. (2020). Precision measurements of the 138Ba+ clock transition. Physical Review Letters, 124, 193001.
